funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals at any stage of their career for grants up to £8,000; grants of £8,001-£20,000 require postdoctoral level or equivalent research experience or above. Open to international applicants.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for individuals undertaking research in British art, including research travel and/or research time (including backfill for those in employment) and some additional costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants

amount.raw: Tiered: Small up to £2,000; Large from £2,001 to £6,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals at any stage in their career who are the author or editor of the proposed publication, with a publisher confirmed and a publication date scheduled within three years of applying.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals to disseminate research on British art through publication of monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles, covering costs such as images, subventions, external contributors' fees and translation.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals enrolled to start (with a place confirmed) or already undertaking a master's level or doctoral level degree in the field of British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals beginning or continuing a master's or doctoral degree in British art who may face barriers to undertaking their course of study.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to registered students at undergraduate level and above, from any country, researching historical works on paper from the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries.
opportunities.summary: From the Andrew Wyld Fund, supports research trips to examine works on paper (prints, drawings and watercolours) from the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries firsthand.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship

amount.raw: Total of £32,000 for one year, or split over two years for part-time study

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals who have applied for or are in receipt of an offer of a master's degree place at a UK-based institution, due to begin between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support a master's degree (MA, MPhil, MSc or equivalent) in British art that brings new perspectives to the field, part of the New Narratives scheme to increase diversity of perspectives.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship

amount.raw: Total of £96,000 awarded as £32,000 a year for three years (or split over further years)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals who have applied for or are in receipt of an offer of a doctorate degree place at a UK-based institution, due to begin between April 2027 and April 2028. International applicants may apply but the amount is fixed at £32,000 per year.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support a doctorate in British art, covering university fees with the remainder supporting living expenses, part of the New Narratives scheme to increase diversity of perspectives in the field.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship

amount.raw: One year at £35,000, or two years at £70,000 (paid at £35,000 per year)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals at postdoctoral level (or with equivalent experience) or above.
opportunities.summary: Financial support to undertake a major research project in British art that reshapes understanding of the field, part of the New Narratives scheme.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship

amount.raw: Three-month stay at the British School at Rome with full board and accommodation, plus an honorarium

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals with at least a first degree, from pre-doctoral PhD candidates to those internationally recognised in their field.
opportunities.summary: Provides a three-month residency at the British School at Rome for individuals undertaking advanced research on a British-Italian topic relating to cultural contact, exchange and influence between Britain and Italy.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications are welcomed. Organisations can only apply for one Research Project Grant per round.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for organisations undertaking ambitious and sustained research projects in the field of British art, primarily supporting staff costs towards facilitation of a research project with public-facing outcomes and/or legacy.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Exhibition Publication Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit; the exhibition on which the publication is based can be forthcoming or already have taken place.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to produce publications related to their exhibitions and displays, including costs such as image and production costs, to disseminate research on British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Event Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications are welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to disseminate research on British art through live, online and hybrid events intended for a variety of audiences, covering costs such as venue hire, accommodation for speakers and staffing.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking a conservation research project or technical analysis which will lead to a research project. Items must be in public or charitable ownership and accessible to the public.
opportunities.summary: Support organisations to protect and preserve significant works of British art by funding original and needed conservation research on items from their own collections, including staff and equipment costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Digitisation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking work to digitise items and material in their own collections.
opportunities.summary: Support organisations to make their collections freely available to audiences online via digitisation, covering personnel and equipment costs for digitising photographic, archival collections, bound volumes, objects, paintings, publications or other assets relating to British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: ERBA Research Travel Bursaries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to Members of Emerging Researchers in British Art (ERBA); those with pending membership may apply.
opportunities.summary: Micro-grant for ERBA members to support a specific research trip (e.g. to a gallery, museum, collection or site, or to meet a contact), covering transport, accommodation and reasonable expenses, to be used between November 2026 and April 2027.
